title: QA run · milestone:#35547 (32/32) · 305fe60e · 2026-11-24 · 23 PASS / 7 PARTIAL / 2 FAIL / 0 BLOCKED / 0 NOT-RUN
body:
qa#1 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYpxQpmErd1ixfkgbYh

Milestone acceptance on main for epic #35547 (all children closed; #34632 D2-A signal ②; the maintainer's 2026-11-24 direction to test on main, not on a release). Filed by the seat from runner `session_01QSeKYkNKNUdaZdAtxeG3vG`'s report (Sonnet orchestrator with Sonnet helpers); the runner made no GitHub write.

## Environment
- Framework sha `305fe60e6e97dcd1e13175503c9523e3a5780808`, detached at `origin/main`. The tree was clean, and the console was built from `ui/` in the same tree.
- Build chain on a cold tree: `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`, then `pnpm build --concurrency=2`, then `pnpm console:build --concurrency=2`. All exited 0.
- Boot: `os dev --ui --seed-admin --no-watch -p 41701 -d file:/tmp/qa/list/data.db`, with `OS_PORT=41701` and its own uploads root. The first boot compiled the artifact.
- Chromium 1243 through Playwright, 1280×800 and 1167×762, zh-CN, addressed as `localhost`. Sequential run; the dashboards epic ran in parallel in a subagent.
- Fixtures I staged on the boot's own DB:
  - 130 `showcase_inquiry` rows and 120 `showcase_task` rows, via `createMany`, to get past the 50-row window.
  - A member persona, minted by admin create-user plus change-password.
  - One view with `pagination: {pageSize: 50}`, written into the `com.example.showcase.custom` pair.
- The cards cite HotCRM, which is not in this checkout. I substituted the showcase (tasks, projects, inquiries).
- Pin run: the three `35876` header-menu and sort-reorder files, `vitest --maxWorkers=1`, 3 files and 22 tests passed. That is jsdom, component layer only.
- Not run, and not scored beyond the others:
  - Dark mode of the geometry.
  - The 375 px leg. Epic #35547 excludes phone lists.

## Promises (from the children's 「要做的」 and 「验收」, in the card's words)
- **#35548 frame**
  - F1 视图栏：视图类型图标、视图名、记录数、下拉箭头；右边「筛选」「排序」「选项」和搜索图标
  - F2 表头、单元格、两条栏的按钮统一 13 号字，密度与行线
  - F3 每个有统计的列在自己列下显示，右边缘对齐 ≤1px，没有相叠的冒号
  - F4 看板视图下两条栏与表格视图一致
- **#35549 filter**
  - Q1 点「筛选」出可搜索字段清单，显示字段在前，类型图标，「高级筛选」
  - Q2 选项字段带颜色多选，勾一个生效一个，≤4 次点击不需打字
  - Q3 条件标签，点 × 删除，记录数同步，重置
  - Q4 视图自带条件也显示成标签，不可删除
  - Q5 用户 A 的筛选 B 看不到
  - Q6 不再出现「其中」
- **#35550 sort**
  - S1 点「排序」，点一个字段立即生效（≤3 点击）
  - S2 排序以标签显示，点标签切换升降序，点 × 删除
  - S3 多级排序，可拖动调整
  - S4 表头排序与标签同一个状态
  - S5 重置回到视图保存的排序
  - S6 方向文字按字段类型（日期、数字「小 → 大」、文本「A → Z」）
- **#35551 options**
  - O1 菜单：视图名、布局、字段、分组、行高、更多
  - O2 字段清单可搜索、拖动、点眼睛隐藏；≤3 点击隐藏列；刷新后保持
  - O3 无无文字图标按钮，没有「对象声明」
  - O4 A 隐藏的列 B 仍看得到
- **#35553 view switch and create**
  - V1 下拉有搜索、类型图标、我的视图与共享视图分组、底部「添加视图」
  - V2 原地新建小卡片，看不到 snake_case
  - V3 普通成员也能新建，建出来是「我的视图」，别人看不到
  - V4 带着未保存的筛选新建，新视图里有同样的标签
  - V5 「管理视图」入口还在
- **#35554 selection, actions, scroll**
  - A1 取消「操作」列，悬停无行尾控件（1280 和 1167 各一遍）
  - A2 勾选后显示「已选 N 条」和针对所选的操作，1 条与 2 条不同
  - A3 右键菜单，「删除」最后有分隔
  - A4 滚动加载、无页码、记录数是总数、「选择全部 M 条」
  - A5 声明了 `pagination` 的视图仍分页
  - A6 点进记录再返回，回到原来的滚动位置
  - A7 合计由服务端按全部记录计算

## Verdict table: promises
- F1 PARTIAL — icon → name → count → caret reads in order (`list-view-switcher-*`); page bar 44, view bar 40, condition row 40. 「筛选」「排序」 sit in the condition row and 「选项」 is 「视图设置」 beside the name, not at the bar's right, per #36113 and #35878. The calendar view's switcher has no count.
- F2 FAIL — header and rows measure 36/36 at first-row top 160 (as #36069 set them). Computed type is 12px on header text and 14px on cell text, the condition buttons, the switcher, 视图设置 and 新建. The card and `list-view-capabilities` A10 say 13px. Reproduced on two fresh loads.
- F3 PARTIAL — a footer total sits under its own column, with no doubled colon. Currency 合计 right edge 827 equals the row values' right edge, but the header edge is 839 (12 px of cell padding). Rollup columns (任务数, 总预计工时) and the progress column draw values left-aligned, and their totals follow that.
- F4 PASS — board, calendar and cards share the same three rows (44/40/40). The 29 px shift on the board view comes from that view's action notice banner.
- Q1 PASS — `condition-popover-add` has a 搜索字段 input, 视图中显示 before 隐藏的字段, an icon per field, and a 高级筛选 footer.
- Q2 PASS — 筛选 → 状态 → 进行中 → 评审中 is 4 clicks and no typing. The request carries `filter=["or",["status","=","in_progress"],["status","=","in_review"]]`, and the count and rows go from 10 to 4.
- Q3 PASS — clicking the chip reopens the value list. × sends no `filter`, and the count returns to 10. 放弃 restores the view state.
- Q4 PASS — on 进行中 the chip `view-condition-chip` has `data-locked="true"`, a dashed style, no button inside, and the title 视图自带的条件，不能在这里删除.
- Q5 PASS — a fresh-context member never sees the admin's chips. `sys_user_preference` holds only `ui.recent` and `ui.app.last`, with no filter value. Per #35955 the filter is a draft and is not remembered across a reload; the card's 「换浏览器还在」 is stale.
- Q6 PASS — the advanced panel reads 「筛选记录 | 添加筛选」, with no 其中 and no Where.
- S1 PASS — 排序 → 降序 → 进度 is 3 clicks and sends `sort=-progress`.
- S2 PARTIAL — the chip reads 「按 进度 排序」 and 「+N」, ahead of 筛选. A click opens the levels panel, with × per level; it does not flip the direction (#35876).
- S3 PASS — ArrowDown on a handle changes the request from `sort=-progress,updated_at` to `sort=updated_at,-progress`. A mouse drag restores it.
- S4 PASS — a header-menu pick of 升序排列 on 标题 gives `sort=title,-progress,updated_at`, and the chip reads 「按 标题 排序 +2」.
- S5 PASS — 放弃 gives no `sort` and the chip returns to 「排序」.
- S6 FAIL — number fields (`estimate_hours` is `number`, `progress` is `progress`) show 「A → Z / Z → A」 in the chip panel's direction select. `date` shows 「最早 → 最新」. The `size_asc` word 「小 → 大」 exists in the locale but is never drawn. Reproduced on two fresh loads.
- O1 PARTIAL — 视图名, 显示的列, 布局, 分组, 行高 and 恢复默认 are present. 「更多」 (record-open mode, row numbers, inline edit) is absent, superseded by #35747 and the record-open ruling.
- O2 PARTIAL — 添加列 has a 搜索字段 input, and ArrowDown and mouse drag reorder immediately. Hiding takes 2 clicks and re-adding takes 3. Hide and reorder form a draft (放弃/保存). The draft survives opening a record and returning, but a reload drops it. The card's 「刷新后保持」 is superseded by #35955.
- O3 PASS — 0 icon-only buttons without a label, no 对象声明, and the reset reads 恢复默认.
- O4 PASS — after the admin hid 进度, the member still sees all 7 columns.
- V1 PASS — `list-view-switcher-search`, a type icon per row, 共享视图 and 我的视图 groups, and 添加视图 and 管理视图 at the bottom.
- V2 PASS — the card (`create-view-card`) has name, type (10 types), 分组字段 (状态 for kanban), scope, and 创建. It is 5 clicks plus a name. Writes: `POST sys_personal_view` plus a preference patch, with no `/meta` write. No snake_case text appears on the page.
- V3 PASS — the member card has no scope switch and no 管理视图. The member creates 「成员视图」 through `POST sys_personal_view`. A member forged `PUT /api/v1/meta/view/showcase_task.qa_forged` returns 403 `FORBIDDEN` (needs `manage_metadata`). The member lists only their own personal view.
- V4 PASS — with a draft filter, the card reads 「包含当前的筛选和排序」, and the new view shows 「优先级：低」.
- V5 PASS — 管理视图 is present for the admin and absent for the member.
- A1 PASS — headers are 标题…进度 with no 操作 column. Hover shows 选择行 and 在侧边打开 only. At 1167×762 the last column's right edge is 1167 with no clipping.
- A2 PARTIAL — 「已选 1 条」 shows 重新打开 / 重新分配… / 快速查看 / 更多. 「已选 2 条」 shows 重算所选 / 标记为完成 / 重算工时 / 更多. The bar floats bottom-centre (x-centre 768, y 707, h 44) as #36021 set it. The card said it swaps the page bar and leaves no bottom bar.
- A3 PASS — menu: 复制, 粘贴, 清空, 修改历史, —, 打开, 在新标签页打开, —, 编辑, 标记为完成, 重新分配…, 快速查看, —, 删除. The last item is red (`rgb(185,28,28)`).
- A4 PASS — 133 inquiries: `top=50`, then `skip=50`, then `skip=100`, count 133, no pager. After select-all the bar reads 「已选 50 条 | 选择全部 133 条」, then 「已选择全部 133 项（全部匹配）」.
- A5 PASS — the view with `pagination` pages as 「第 1 页，共 3 页」, with 上一页 and 下一页.
- A6 PARTIAL — the page's own ✕ returns to scrollTop 1840 with 133 rows. Browser Back returns at scrollTop 4 on three runs with a 6 s settle.
- A7 PASS — the footer Sum over 130 tasks, with 50 loaded, reads 721. The request is `POST /api/v1/data/showcase_task/query` with `aggregations` count and `sum_estimate_hours`. The API sum is 721.

## Verdict table: checklist items used as evidence (not in the title count)
- `records-forms.list-view-capabilities` rev15 FAIL
  - Clauses driven: acceptance[1] PASS, [3] PASS, [4] PASS, [10] FAIL (13px; geometry half PASS), [11] FAIL (footer count). The rest are NOT-RUN.
- `records-forms.adhoc-filter-sort-builder` rev15 PARTIAL
  - Clauses driven: acceptance[0] PASS, [1] PASS, [3] PASS, [4] PASS. Clause [2] is only partly driven (draft survives a record and return; the reload-drop not driven for filters). Clause [5] is NOT-RUN.
- `records-forms.list-header-menu-and-sort-levels` rev1 PARTIAL
  - Clauses driven: acceptance[1] PASS, [2] PASS, [5] PASS, [6] PASS, [7] PASS (22 tests, jsdom). Clauses [3] and [4] are NOT-RUN.
- `records-forms.saved-view-management` rev4 PARTIAL
  - Clauses driven: acceptance[2] PASS, [3] PASS, [4] PASS. Clauses [0] and [1] are NOT-RUN.
- `records-forms.bulk-select-all-matching` rev12 PARTIAL
  - Clause driven: acceptance[0] PASS. The rest are NOT-RUN.
- No checklist item covers Options-menu contents (O1–O4), the filter field list (Q1, Q2, Q4, Q6), or the footer server totals (A7), so those were driven by hand.

## Reproduction rules (each FAIL)
1. **F2 type size**
   - Admin, open `/_console/apps/com.example.showcase/showcase_task`, wait for network idle.
   - Read the computed `font-size` of the text node inside `thead th` 项目, inside `[data-testid=primary-field-link]`, and of `[data-testid=condition-sort]`.
   - Expected 13px each. Actual 12px / 14px / 14px.
2. **S6 number direction words**
   - On `showcase_task`, click `[data-testid=condition-sort]`, then `[data-testid=sort-panel-fields-item-estimate_hours]`, then Escape.
   - Click `condition-sort` again, then `[data-testid=sort-builder-direction]`, and read the options.
   - Expected 「小 → 大」 and 「大 → 小」. Actual 「A → Z」 and 「Z → A」.
   - The same happens for `progress`. `due_date` shows 「最早 → 最新」 correctly.
3. **`list-view-capabilities` acceptance[11] footer count**
   - On `showcase_task`, read the left edge of the text 「10 条记录」 in `[data-testid=data-table-summary-lead]` against `record-list-host`'s left (256).
   - Expected 16 ±1. Actual 52 on tasks and on projects. The select-all box and the page-bar tile read 16.

## Acceptance reading
The list redo largely holds on main, with two real defects and several promises whose wording was overtaken by later maintainer rulings.
- **Holds:** the filter and sort flow, in-place view creation, locked view conditions, scroll loading, server totals, the bulk menus, and isolation between users.
- **Defects:** 13px type, number sort wording, and footer-count position.
- **Overtaken by later rulings:** the bar swap became a floating bar, 「重置」 became 放弃/保存, 「选项」 became 「视图设置」, and filters and hides became drafts.

## Off-clause probes
About 6 minutes. Doors and boundary values:
- Unknown view id: `/view/showcase_task.nonexistent` silently renders 全部任务 with no notice.
- No-match field search: 「没有匹配的字段」.
- Empty view name: 创建 disabled.
- Whitespace-only name: 创建 disabled.
- Duplicate name, both a shared view and my own: refused with 「已存在同名视图。」.
- 120-character name: accepted.
- 1167 px width.
- Member persona against the admin's personal view and a forged shared write.

I found no card-worthy defect beyond the above.

## Setup time versus test time
- Setup: about 15.5 minutes from the start of install to the second server answering health. The cold tree needed install, `pnpm build` and `pnpm console:build`. I spent roughly another 10 minutes reading the epics, the issues, `RUNNER.md` and the skills and mapping promises to items, overlapping the build.
- Testing: about 45 minutes of hands-on list-page driving, in parallel with the dashboards subagent's roughly 46 minutes. Total wall clock was about 70 minutes.
- The off-clause probes took about 6 minutes.
- Deviations from the brief:
  - I booted one server per epic rather than one per item.
  - Dark mode, and the Studio, `optionsFrom` and single-value-synonym legs, were not run.
  - One subagent was used, not two.
